q: How much does a video cost?
a: It depends on what the project needs to do. Budgets run from $1,000 to $1,000,000, and we've managed projects all across that range. Most land in the thousands to tens of thousands; bigger campaigns and series run into the hundreds of thousands. This industry loves smoke and mirrors, so we skip them: tell us your goal and your budget, and you'll get a straight, fair number fast.

q: How long does a video take?
a: As little as a day, as long as a year. Experience lets us turn a shoot and edit around in a single day when you need it. Projects with more strategy, writing, production and post take longer. Either way, you'll know the schedule before we start.
Phoenix, Arizona. We work all over, though: across Arizona, for national brands, and on location as far away as Ireland.

a: One of our three founders leads every project, from the first call to the final cut.
